name: Audit Design System Consistency
summary: Audit whether rendered surfaces use a coherent design-system contract without mistaking a token inventory for user experience.
description: Audit design-system consistency across specified UI surfaces by examining tokens, component variants, states, responsive behavior, and accessible semantics with explicit evidence and uncertainty. Use when a design system or component set needs review.
risk_reason: This skill audits whether rendered surfaces use a coherent design-system contract without mistaking a token inventory for user experience; it does not declare a design system consistent from token names or source code alone.
refuses: It does not declare a design system consistent from token names or source code alone.
It does not invent intended visual hierarchy, brand rules, or inaccessible acceptance criteria.
It does not replace design review, accessibility testing, or product approval with an audit.

operational.latency_reason: The skill audits whether rendered surfaces use a coherent design-system contract without mistaking a token inventory for user experience, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
